ops.quote: Self-attention has the promise of improving computer vision systems
Self-attention models have recently been shown to have encouraging improvements
We propose two extensions to self-attention that, in conjunction with a more efficient implementation of self-attention
We propose two extensions to self-attention that, in conjunction with a more efficient implementation of self-attention
In this work, we aim to develop self-attention models that can outperform not just the canonical baseline models
We leverage these improvements to develop a new self-attention model family, HaloNets
HaloNets, which reach state-of-the-art accuracies on the parameter-limited setting of the ImageNet classification benchmark
In preliminary transfer learning experiments, we find that HaloNet models outperform much larger models
On harder tasks such as object detection and instance segmentation, our simple local self-attention and convolution, hybrids show improvements over very strong baselines
